story.lion.title: The Lion and the Mouse
story.lion.p1: A big lion was sleeping under a tree in the forest.
story.lion.p2: A little mouse ran over his nose by mistake, and the lion woke up.
story.lion.p3: The lion caught the mouse in his paw. “I will eat you!” he roared.
story.lion.p4: “Please let me go,” said the mouse. “One day I will help you.”
story.lion.p5: The lion laughed, but he was kind. He opened his paw and let the mouse go.
story.lion.p6: A few days later, the lion was caught in a hunter’s net. He could not get out.
story.lion.p7: The little mouse heard him. She chewed the ropes with her sharp teeth until the lion was free.
story.lion.p8: The lion thanked his small friend. The lesson: be kind to everyone; even a small friend can help.
story.crow.title: The Thirsty Crow
story.crow.p1: It was a hot summer day, and a crow was very thirsty.
story.crow.p2: He flew everywhere looking for water.
story.crow.p3: At last he saw a pot in a garden.
story.crow.p4: There was a little water at the bottom, but his beak could not reach it.
story.crow.p5: The crow did not give up. He looked around and saw some small stones.
story.crow.p6: He dropped the stones into the pot, one by one.
story.crow.p7: Slowly the water came up, higher and higher, until he could drink.
story.crow.p8: The crow drank happily and flew away. The lesson: think, keep trying, and you will find a way.
story.ant.title: The Ant and the Dove
story.ant.p1: One day a little ant went to the river to drink water.
story.ant.p2: A wave came, and the ant fell into the river.
story.ant.p3: A dove sitting in a tree saw the ant.
story.ant.p4: She dropped a leaf into the water. The ant climbed onto the leaf and reached the land.
story.ant.p5: Later, a hunter came and wanted to throw his net over the dove.
story.ant.p6: The ant saw it and bit the hunter’s foot.
story.ant.p7: “Ouch!” cried the hunter. The dove heard him and flew away to safety.
story.ant.p8: The ant and the dove became good friends. The lesson: when you help others, they will help you too.
story.tortoise.title: The Tortoise and the Hare
story.tortoise.p1: A hare was very proud of how fast he could run.
story.tortoise.p2: He laughed at a tortoise. “You are so slow!”
story.tortoise.p3: “Let us have a race,” said the tortoise calmly.
story.tortoise.p4: The race began, and the hare ran far ahead.
story.tortoise.p5: Near the end, the hare thought, “I have time,” and he fell asleep under a tree.
story.tortoise.p6: The tortoise walked slowly, but he never stopped.
story.tortoise.p7: When the hare woke up, the tortoise was already at the finish line.
story.tortoise.p8: The hare learned to be humble. The lesson: slow and steady wins the race.
story.woodcutter.title: The Honest Woodcutter
story.woodcutter.p1: A poor woodcutter was cutting wood near a river.
story.woodcutter.p2: His axe slipped from his hands and fell into the deep water.
story.woodcutter.p3: He sat down and cried, because the axe was all he had.
story.woodcutter.p4: A kind river fairy came up with a golden axe. “Is this yours?”
story.woodcutter.p5: “No,” said the woodcutter. Then she showed him a silver axe. “No, that is not mine either.”
story.woodcutter.p6: At last she showed him his old iron axe. “Yes, that is mine!” he said with joy.
story.woodcutter.p7: The fairy was happy with his honesty and gave him all three axes.
story.woodcutter.p8: The woodcutter went home with a happy heart. The lesson: always tell the truth.
story.ghost.title: The Little Ghost Who Shared
story.ghost.p1: In an old house on a hill lived a little ghost called Boo.
story.ghost.p2: Boo had a lantern that glowed with a warm orange light.
story.ghost.p3: One night, a small girl was lost in the dark woods near the house.
story.ghost.p4: She was cold and scared, and she began to cry.
story.ghost.p5: Boo floated down quietly and held up his lantern.
story.ghost.p6: “Don’t be afraid,” he said softly. “I will light your way home.”
story.ghost.p7: They walked together until she saw her house. She smiled and waved goodbye.
story.ghost.p8: That night, Boo’s lantern seemed to glow even brighter. The lesson: sharing your light makes the world brighter.

home.welcomeText: Welcome to Phantom Voice Kit, a set of voice apps. Fill in a form by speaking, learn a topic by listening, see a form in your own language, play the memory game, learn words in the picture book, count with pumpkins, listen to stories, keep voice notes and find your saved documents. In Calm time you can meditate, time your walk or exercise and keep a daily routine. With Speak and translate you can talk with anyone in another language. Choose an app below. Everything works in your own language. In Talk and learn you practise real conversations to speak a new language. In Kolam puzzle you draw one line through every dot.
